title: Email
unassigned: No Microsoft 365 mailbox is assigned to your account. A super admin can assign one with the users:assign-mailbox command. This screen uses only your own mailbox.
signatureHelp: This text is added at the end of every message you send.
headerHelp: This image is placed at the top of every message you send.
headerSizeHelp: Width of the image in the message, from 20 to 100. The height follows the picture.
footerColorsHelp: Add up to 8 colored boxes. They appear under the signature on every message you send. Select a box to remove it.
subject: Subject
attachmentUnavailable: This file could not be opened.
attachmentMissing: This message has an attachment. Refresh the mailbox, then open the message again.
messageRequired: Write at least 8 characters before sending.
sentNotice: Microsoft 365 accepted the message for sending.
received: Microsoft 365 receives mail in this mailbox. This page reads it when you open the folder or click Refresh. It does not collect new mail while the page is closed.
select: Select a message to read it as plain text.
stationeryHelp: These sections are written into the message, the same way Outlook places a signature. The company logo is not attached as a file.
layoutHelp: Choose a blank message or a layout. The header, signature, and footer sit in the message, where you can edit them before sending.
layoutBlankDetail: A clear page with your signature at the bottom.
layoutNoteDetail: A short note with your signature.
layoutAnnouncementDetail: A centered title for a notice.
layoutProjectDetail: A labeled update with your letterhead.
layoutFollowUpDetail: A short follow-up under your header.
